harness_gaps: 1. key_chord support: hold two scancodes simultaneously (SC_X + SC_ALT) across the 30-frame gap window so KBD_Key held-state polls register the chord. Unlocks every Alt+X quit scenario (menu/register/hangar/store/load/help/shipcomp) on the C side. Highest leverage single addition (7 scenarios touch it), but each also needs Godot to implement Alt+X (currently unimplemented everywhere).

2. text_entry support: inject per-character g_ascii keydowns (printable 32-126), SC_BACKSPACE, with the same 30-frame pacing, honoring I_TOUPPER. Required only for REG_NAME / REG_CALLSIGN, but those gate the entire pilot-creation -> AskDiff -> Hangar path that already has Godot support; this is the most valuable enabler for end-to-end flows. Godot already implements text entry (letters/digits/Backspace), so this is purely a harness-side script-command gap.

3. mouse_click support: inject a pointer (x,y in 320x200) + B1 click pulse routed to SWD_CheckMouse / HandlePointerClick. Unlocks LOAD_CANCEL field path, REG view-area commit/idpic, SHIPCOMP GAME1/2/3 + secret gadget + B1-B3 lights, and all view-area hover-hint fields. Note: many of these have no Godot mouse path (HandlePointerClick has no Store/Help/Credits/LoadMission/AskBool branch), so harness mouse alone is insufficient without Godot work.

4. slider_drag support (builds on mouse_click): drag with a captured per-frame PTR_X to set absolute volume values (non-multiples-of-8 like 53) that the keyboard +/-8 path cannot reach. Needed only for OPTS_VMUSIC/OPTS_VFX arbitrary-value parity and the ASK_DRAGBAR window move. Lowest priority; the 8-step keyboard path already covers all multiple-of-8 volumes.

5. tab_field_nav (keyboard, may already work): SC_TAB / Caps+TAB to move active_field for FLD_BUTTON windows (HELP_UP/DOWN/DONE, SHIPCOMP GAME buttons) and gate on usekb_flag==TRUE so difficulty/game buttons are keyboard-selectable. Confirm the parity build sets usekb_flag=TRUE (auto input mode) or these buttons silently fall back to mouse-only on the C side.

6. attract/idle-timer determinism: pin DEMO_DELAY frame counter (and HANG_PIC random(3) flicker, WIN_Msg/Order/Credits IMS_WaitTimed timeouts) so frame-count-driven transitions do not diverge under the 30-frame-gap pacing. Seed/exclude RNG-driven icon state from the menu-event recorder.

Order: chord (1) and text_entry (2) first - cheap harness-only commands that unlock the most keyboard scenarios and the create-pilot spine. Then mouse_click (3) + its Godot HandlePointerClick branches, then slider_drag (4) on top. tab_field_nav (5) and timer-determinism (6) are verification/config rather than new modalities. Independent of harness: ~47 elements need Godot implementation first (MAIN_RETURN, Alt+X everywhere, OPTS pointer icons, REG idpic, HANG_MAIN_MENU/QSAVE, LOAD_DEL, SHIPCOMP games/secret/cheats/per-sector, WIN_Pause/WIN_Order, LoadComp progress) - these are blocked_by godot_* tags, not by the harness.
